name: drive
description: Google Drive tools (read only): search files and list a folder, and read a Doc, Sheet, Slides deck or text file as text.

config.label: Service account key
config.hint: The key file Google gives you for a service account: paste its JSON, or give the path to the file on the Pepe server, or write ${ENV_VAR}. Share the folders it should read with the account's e-mail. It sees only what is shared with it.
